elements.text: The moth and the butterfly keep their art and colors. The feed adds a look on top so they read as drawn, not as creatures in space.
Raw · as in the game today

texts.line: Two of these stars are planets. Can you find the second?

elements.text: Plate on a 45° leader; the gold dot = speaking
1px signal line on the outline, 90%: it shimmers more the farther from the orb, and the pulse lights it as it passes.
the art at 85%: stars show through the wings.
a flat dashed ellipse under it, signal 50%: where the feed thinks it is.
the UI's scanlines: fine rings from the orb across the wings; now and then a wing edge drops out and comes back. Calm: still.
moving fast: a teal outline one frame behind. Calm: off.
callsign on a leader (SURVEYOR, C.O-R.I), mono 9: on deploy and on hover, else hidden.
the treatment is added on top, never recolors (Effects: characters keep their colors).
Cori's plate replaces the speech bubble: Plate (surface/60 + blur), C.O-R.I eyebrow, Inter 14, types out; calm = whole line at once.

knowledge.text: Projection treatment on both avatars: rim (1px signal 90%), art at 85%, dashed tracking ring, still scanlines (10%), teal ghost when fast, callsign tag on deploy/hover. Colors and the fire stay.
knowledge.why: User: "let's add the projection treatment and see how it looks." Judge it on the canvas, then in the game.

knowledge.text: Cori speaks on a Plate tied to the butterfly by a leader line (replaces CoriBubble's rounded black bubble); eyebrow C.O-R.I, live dot gold while speaking.

The moth and Cori are projected like all the overlay, from the orb: rings across their wings, a rim that shimmers with distance (the moth in his tank barely; out flying, the most), the pulse lighting the rim as it passes, now and then a wing edge dropping out. Their own extras stay: tracking ring, ghost when fast, callsign tag.
knowledge.why: User, 2026-11-22: everything is emitted from the orb, "same goes for the moth and Cori... all of it does".

agent.brief: Draw the moth and the butterfly as feed avatars: their current canvas art (lunaMoth.ts, butterfly.ts) plus an overlay pass.
rules: Reduced motion: no scanlines, no ghost.
Cori = the butterfly: CoriBubble anchors to the butterfly and draws as a Plate + leader.

Treatment is a second pass after the wings draw (canvas): stroke the same outline in signal; clip to the wing path and stroke arcs centred on the orb's screen position (1px every 3px, signal 7–16%), so the rings line up with the UI's; displace the rim by low-frequency noise scaled by distance to the orb; when the pulse radius (shared with the DOM runtime: al-projection-pulse, 1.4px/ms) crosses the avatar, stroke the rim bright; every 5–18 s skip one wing's rim for 0.4–1 s. globalAlpha 0.85 on the art.
open: Ghost offset: one frame of velocity, or fixed px?
